programme.title: The Zoo: New Chick on the Block
programme.desc: A popular sea lion falls ill after ingesting a foreign object the avian team devises a plan to increase the cock-of-the-rocks population.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Stronger Together
programme.desc: Dogs in Africa and the Arctic help man survive in extreme conditions.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Wicked Bite
programme.desc: Jim Lane picks blueberries alone in the Blue Ridge Mountains until a timber rattlesnake attacks teacher Rachael Lilienthal's swim in a Florida river becomes a struggle when an alligator bites down on her arm, pulls her underwater and doesn't let go.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Oscar the Grouchy Frogmouth
programme.desc: Terri returns to her hometown in Oregon to help Brady, a cougar in need of a vital health check at the zoo, Robert is on a mission to rescue Oscar, a small bird with a big attitude Bindi bathes an echidna with bad skin allergies.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Out on a Limb
programme.desc: Tom must navigate a sloping tree to rescue a difficult cat Shaun faces wet and damp conditions to save a friendly, homesick stray.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.: The Forgotten Giants
programme.desc: Not all poaching is for horns and tusks. In many parts of poverty-stricken Africa, giraffes are killed mercilessly for their meat. Ivan joins a specialized team in exploring radical solutions to save giraffes and provide food to communities.

programme.title: Mystery of the Black Demon Shark
programme.desc: In Mexico, legends swirl around El Demonio Negro, a 50-foot shark that has terrorized fishermen and tourists alike for generations Forrest Galante hunts for answers in the most rugged and remote parts of the Baja Peninsula.

programme.title: The Zoo: Beloved Bugs
programme.desc: The zoo anxiously awaits the arrival of a snow leopard called K2's fourth cub the staff is pleased when a pair of Andean condors embrace their new enclosure, while a squirmy binturong fights his annual vaccination.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Billion Dollar Dogs
programme.desc: Discovering the wide variety of jobs dogs are capable of.
